content.short: The Tipsy Turtles is an animated series for the Cardano NFT scene.
content.description:
The Tipsy Turtles is an animated series for the Cardano NFT scene. It features two characters - Ted and Tony the Turtle and their interactions with over 20 of Cardano's most beloved PFP projects. Minting a Tipsy Turtle will also give you access to TripHut.

The Tipsy Turtles IP will manifest at the onset as digital collectibles on the Cardano Blockchain, supported by animated content.

In the lead up to mint, the project will be releasing a 36-episode animated series for the Cardano NFT scene using some of the blockchain’s favorite characters – the characters can be seen in the wallet $animints. Let’s co-write season 2 and beyond together, and at some point, enjoy novel utility, courtesy of TripHut.

The Tipsy Turtles is brought to you by Yaad Labs X AniMints – an ambitious team looking to deliver Cardano's first Major IP Success.

Mission: To experiment with Web 3 Tools, Story Telling and In-Real-Life experiences to bring value to our community, to the greatest extent of our creative abilities.

Vision: To become meaningful intellectual property.
